name: Peter Damian
biography: Eleventh-century monk and reformer, follower of the hermit Romuald, who reluctantly served as papal legate; author of a treatise On Divine Omnipotence arguing God can act contrary to the law of contradiction and can undo the past (a view later rejected by Aquinas); led the successful anti-simony campaign at Milan in 1059.
key_arguments: God's power to act contrary to the law of contradiction
